# Theme blocks

Files in `blocks/`. Blocks whose name starts with `_` are private: they only appear in sections that list them in their schema.

## _buy-buttons

File: `blocks/_buy-buttons.liquid` · Editor name: **Buy buttons** · private

Quantity, add to cart with the wishlist toggle beside it (an icon button, named
for screen readers with aria-label and aria-pressed), and dynamic checkout buttons. Works with no JavaScript
(a normal form post); assets/product-form.js upgrades it to add without a
page load. Private to product sections.

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show_quantity` | checkbox | Show quantity selector | `true` |
| `show_dynamic_checkout` | checkbox | Show dynamic checkout buttons | `true` |

## _color-siblings

File: `blocks/_color-siblings.liquid` · Editor name: **Color siblings** · private

Color siblings: separate products that are the same product in another color, shown
as chip-shaped swatch links, the same chip as the size options. Server-rendered, no JavaScript. Private to the product section.

Reads the product metafield singi.color_siblings (list of products, the whole group,
this product included, the same list on every member) and each member's singi.color
(hex). Renders nothing for a product with no group. The list order is the swatch order,
so it is the same on every page of the group; a list that omits this product shows it
first. A member without a color shows its title as a text chip instead. A visible
"Color" label sits above, styled like the other option labels, and names the navigation.
Square 44px chips, corner radius and selected state shared with .chip in assets/base.css.

Why a product list, and the one metafield read per member inside the loop (a bounded
exception to the Liquid cost rule): docs/decisions/003-color-siblings-product-list.md.
Data upkeep: npm run siblings.

_No settings._

## _product-meta

File: `blocks/_product-meta.liquid` · Editor name: **Product meta** · private

SKU, product type and availability in the monospace font, one row per
attribute across the full column: the name at the start, the value at the
end (logical, so it mirrors in right-to-left), with the same line dividers and
padding as a table in prose content (.prose th, td in base.css). The product type
links to Shopify's built-in type collection (url_for_type), and a linked row is
tappable across its full width. Private to product sections.

_No settings._

## _product-price

File: `blocks/_product-price.liquid` · Editor name: **Product price** · private

Price of the selected variant, with its unit price (snippets/unit-price.liquid) when the
merchant set one. Private to product sections.

_No settings._

## _product-title

File: `blocks/_product-title.liquid` · Editor name: **Product title** · private

Product title (the page h1) with the vendor as a monospace eyebrow. The vendor
links to Shopify's built-in vendor collection (url_for_vendor), a filtered list of
every product from that vendor, with no setup in the admin.
Private: only available in sections that list it, like main-product.

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show_vendor` | checkbox | Show vendor | `true` |

## _variant-picker

File: `blocks/_variant-picker.liquid` · Editor name: **Variant picker** · private

Option picker. Radios with real labels: the change handler lives in
assets/product-form.js and refetches this section through the Section
Rendering API. Options and values come from product.options_with_values, so
no loop ever walks the variants array. Each option also carries the price of the variant it selects (data-price) and, only when that
variant's unit price differs from the current one, the unit price (data-unit-price,
data-unit-label; absent means unchanged), so assets/product-form.js can show them at once
instead of waiting for the server. Private to product sections.

_No settings._

## recently-viewed

File: `blocks/recently-viewed.liquid` · Editor name: **Recently viewed** · public · has preset

Products the visitor looked at recently, as a row of product cards.

Nothing is rendered on the server: assets/product-form.js remembers the handle of every product
page the visitor opens (localStorage `singi-recent`, newest first, up to 12), and this block
fetches a card for each one through templates/product.recent.liquid when it nears the viewport.
The visitor's own browser holds the list, so it is private, needs no cookies or account, and the
page stays fully cacheable. A first-time visitor sees nothing: the block stays hidden until there
is something to show, and the product being viewed is never listed.

Skeleton cards hold the space while the real cards load, so the page does not shift.
Works in any content section; on the product page it is added below the product.

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text | Heading |  |
| `limit` | range | Products to show | `4` |
